requirements: Games and game mods only — ModDB is a database of mods, indie games, addons, and downloads; a SaaS does not fit
Free member account — registration is members-only; account is shared with IndieDB, VRDB, and SlideDB
Register a game/mod/addon from the members area; a public profile page is created automatically
Profile includes About description, gallery, news posts, team list; customization possible (historically staff-approved CSS via support@moddb.com)
moddb.com blocked automated fetch (403) — flow verified via official tutorials and archived pages
preparation: An actual game or mod project with media (screenshots/videos) and files to host
Profile copy: About description written for the audience
workflow: Register at moddb.com (or sign in via IndieDB/VRDB/SlideDB)
From the members area, register the game/mod — the profile page is generated
Fill the profile: About, gallery images, team members, news posts
Upload files/addons through the members-only upload flow
Engage via news posts — they surface to followers and the site feed
watchFor: All submission surfaces are login-gated; nothing public without an account
Some editing features may be buggy/archived per community threads — a dev 'group' may be needed to manage a profile
The network (IndieDB especially) is the better-known surface for indie games
countsAsLive: The game/mod has a public profile page at moddb.com/<type>/<slug> with description, gallery, and downloads
